text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 14: Over all series types, more months of training data lower the CRPS, and the last 3 months add the least'
text.tspan: Figure 14: Over all series types, more months of training data lower the
CRPS, and the last 3 months add the least

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) of a model trained on only the last 6, 9, or 12 months of the 15-month training window, minus the CRPS of the production arm with cleaning, which uses all 15 months. Zero (dashed line, and the 15-month dot by definition) is no change; above zero is a worse forecast. Each vertical line is a 95% interval from resampling whole months of the validation year, July 2025 to June 2026 (53 weekly forecast runs, fold A), with the same months drawn for both arms. Scores are the average over random seeds 0, 1, 2. A shorter window drops whole seasons from the training data. The first column also includes the one battery and the one biofuel series.'
text.tspan: Each dot is the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) of a model trained on only the last 6, 9, or 12 months
of the 15-month training window, minus the CRPS of the production arm with cleaning, which uses all 15 months. Zero
(dashed line, and the 15-month dot by definition) is no change; above zero is a worse forecast.
Each vertical line is a 95% interval from resampling whole months of the validation year, July 2025 to June 2026
(53 weekly forecast runs, fold A), with the same months drawn for both arms. Scores are the average over random
seeds 0, 1, 2. A shorter window drops whole seasons from the training data. The first column also includes the one
battery and the one biofuel series.
